Package com.blackbuild.annodocimal.generator

Class ProjectionPolicy

java.lang.Object
com.blackbuild.annodocimal.generator.ProjectionPolicy
@NullMarked public final class ProjectionPolicy extends Object
Immutable inclusion policy for source projection.

Every policy retains signature closure and valid Java output. Those safety rules are not configurable.

      @Input public Set<DeclarationVisibility> getIncludedVisibilities()

    • isNestedDeclarationsIncluded

      @Input public boolean isNestedDeclarationsIncluded()
      Returns whether otherwise-selected named member types are recursively projected.

      Named members required by signature closure remain included. Local and anonymous classes are never included.

      Returns:
      whether named nested declarations are included

    • isSyntheticDeclarationsIncluded

      @Input public boolean isSyntheticDeclarationsIncluded()
      Returns whether otherwise-selected synthetic declarations are included.
      Returns:
      whether synthetic declarations are included

    • isGroovyRuntimeArtifactsIncluded

      @Input public boolean isGroovyRuntimeArtifactsIncluded()
      Returns whether Groovy runtime interfaces, metadata accessors, and similarly named scaffolding are included. Visible language-level APIs such as property accessors do not count as runtime scaffolding.
      Returns:
      whether Groovy runtime artifacts are included
